entities.name: Codex Mosquensis II
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Codex Mosquensis II is a Greek uncial manuscript of the New Testament Gospels. It is designated by V or 031 in the Gregory-Aland numbering of New Testament manuscripts, and ε75 in the von Soden numbering of New Testament manuscripts. Using the study of comparative writings styles (palaeography), it is dated to the 9th century. The manuscript has several gaps.
